f_01M0X4EJBDPCDH9NYD6BZS3VJN.subject: bathroom_remodel_typical_duration
f_01M0X4EJBDPCDH9NYD6BZS3VJN.content: Bathroom remodel jobs typically run 4-8 weeks depending on scope, per TCR's standard job-type shape.

f_01M0X4EJBEFSEZNRXVEKME9CZ5.subject: bathroom_remodel_phase_sequence
f_01M0X4EJBEFSEZNRXVEKME9CZ5.content: Standard bathroom remodel phasing is demo (1-2 days), rough MEP (2-3 days), tile + waterproofing (5-8 days), then fixtures + finish (1 week).

f_01M0X4EJBEGFKYQS5TWQDAN5GH.subject: bathroom_remodel_material_selection_rule
f_01M0X4EJBEGFKYQS5TWQDAN5GH.content: On bathroom remodels, the customer must pick tile and fixtures before demo starts, with no exceptions.

f_01M0X4EJBEV4ZGVNE9RVXTJNS9.subject: bathroom_remodel_permit_requirement
f_01M0X4EJBEV4ZGVNE9RVXTJNS9.content: A permit pull is always required on bathroom remodel jobs.
